author: clee30
title: Android CMake configure fails: MODULE_LIBRARY plugins cannot be linked via ov_generate_plugins_hpp
signature: target of type MODULE LIBRARY may not be linked into another target in ov generate plugins hpp|Code Issue
key_errors: CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries): Target "openvino_intel_gpu_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into another target.
root_cause: The ov_generate_plugins_hpp() function calls ov_target_link_plugins() which attempts to link MODULE_LIBRARY plugin targets into openvino. MODULE_LIBRARY targets cannot be linked as dependencies. This is a pre-existing CMake infrastructure issue affecting Android builds, triggered by every PR in the merge queue. The GPU plugin (and other plugins) are built as MODULE_LIBRARY but ov_target_link_plugins tries to link them statically. This is a systemic CI issue unrelated to the GPU SDPA changes in PR #37056.
